_readme: Human decisions about the imported community spreadsheet — version-controlled,
so git is the audit trail (same model as corrections/corrections.json).
The Source health page (sheet-sync.html) builds these entries for you; paste
them here and commit. Every decision is carried into the export's provenance.
link   — the spreadsheet map IS this VOD map (overrides the matcher)
reject — it is NOT the candidate the matcher proposed (vodMapId)
ignore — not an OWCS map / junk row; kept in the raw layer, never shown
aliasApprovals[]  a reviewed spelling for a value the importer could not map:
Neither list ever edits VOD-derived data: a link only says two records describe
the same map; both are kept and compared field by field.
